evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the internal HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
rationale: Prevents slowloris-style connection slot exhaustion on the HTTP server by adding an unresettable completion deadline. The author notes that "the impact is low because RPC port binds to localhost by default, so this is a robustness fix rather than a remotely exploitable security issue," making the improvement worthwhile and sound but reasonably deferrable.
